props.gloss_en: the mishna: the keva of a gentile['s animal] and of a neveila is forbidden
Rav Huna: here we deal with one who buys a kid from a gentile
Rav Huna: and we are concerned lest it suckled from a tereifa
one may buy eggs from gentiles, and one is not concerned for neveila nor for tereifa
rather say: we are concerned lest it suckled from a non-kosher [animal]
we, who keep apart from them and separate [our young from them] when we see them -- the Rabbis did not decree on us
they, who do not keep apart from them and do not separate them when they see them -- the Rabbis decreed on them
Shmuel: it teaches one thing: the keva of a gentile's slaughter is neveila
Shmuel: why did they forbid gentiles' cheese? because they curdle it with the skin of the stomach of a neveila
hence the keva itself is permitted

objections.gloss_en: אטו קבת גוי לאו נבלה היא? -- is the gentile's [slaughtered animal's keva] not neveila? why list it separately

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא בלוקח גדי מן הגוי עסקינן -- the case is a kid bought from a gentile (= p_huna_lokeach_gedi)
חדא קתני -- it is one clause: the gentile's slaughter is neveila (= p_shmuel_chada_katani)

objections.gloss_en: ומי חיישינן שמא ינק מן הטרפה? והתנן: לוקחים ביצים מן הגוים ואין חוששין לא משום נבלה ולא משום טרפה
ומאי שנא טרפה דלא חיישינן ומאי שנא טמאה דחיישינן? -- why concern for the one and not the other

answered_by.gloss_en: טרפה לא שכיחא, טמאה שכיחא (= p_tereifa_lo_shechicha, p_temea_shechicha)

objections.gloss_en: אי שכיחא, אפילו גבי דידן ניחוש! -- if it is common, let us be concerned with our own [animals] too

answered_by.gloss_en: we keep apart and separate them -- no decree; they do not -- the Rabbis decreed (= p_lo_gazru_bedidan, p_gazru_begoyim)

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר שמואל הכי? והאמר שמואל: מפני מה אסרו גבינת הגוים -- מפני שמעמידין אותה בעור קבת נבלה; הא קבה גופה שריא!

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: כאן קודם חזרה, כאן לאחר חזרה -- here before the retraction, here after it (Steinsaltz: R' Yehoshua's retraction, Avoda Zara 29b; the mishna before, Shmuel's dictum after)
